items.title: File lawsuit (Klage) against refusal of advertising-sign permit
items.quote: Klage gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe vor dem Verwaltungsgericht Musterkirchen (Domplatz 4, 45879 Musterkirchen) erhoben werden; ein Vorverfahren ist nicht vorgesehen (§ 110 JustG NRW).
items.computation: The letter is internally inconsistent about its own date: the letterhead states 'Datum 30.07.2027' (a Friday), while the body refers to 'diesem Bescheid vom 28.07.2027' (a Wednesday) as if that were the decision's date. Per the instruction to use the earliest plausible date when a letter contradicts itself, I take 28.07.2027 as the (earlier) possible date of issuance/mailing. As a municipal authority decision sent by ordinary post, notification (Bekanntgabe) is governed by § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW: the decision is deemed notified on the third day after it was handed to the post ('Aufgabe zur Post'), i.e. 28.07.2027 + 3 days = 31.07.2027 (a Saturday; this fictional notification date is not shifted for weekends, since it merely fixes when notice is deemed to occur, not a deadline). The one-month Klage period then runs under § 57 VwGO i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (31.07.2027) is not counted, so the period begins 01.08.2027, and a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering (Bekanntgabe) day, i.e. 31.08.2027. 31.08.2027 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies under § 193 BGB. (Using instead the later, letterhead date of 30.07.2027 as the mailing date would give Bekanntgabe on 02.08.2027 and a deadline of 02.09.2027; the earlier, 28.07.2027-based date of 31.08.2027 is used as the more protective, earliest plausible reading.)
